note: M8 benchmark cases (owner, 2026-10-06). A case is a /motion request, the canvas location it was typed on (location, as the card sends it), an optional selection in the pinned source (repository_context, at the source's own commit), and an optional frozen plan; the pair runs only if the request grounds to the plan's own target. Cases without a plan get one from the plan stage; both renderers then take the same frozen plan. Order is the run order: if the budget ends, the later cases are the ones not run.
